items.reason: No way to cheat from the watch found. The watch only talks to the paired phone through the Wear data layer (same signed app only); its listener acts on 5 fixed message paths and none of them change data. The only thing it sends that is saved is a logged set, and the numbers are capped by the crown (weight up to 2000, reps 1 to 999, the same as the phone's boxes) and written as plain numbers, so no extra fields can be slipped in; the phone still decides whether to save it. No check-in, dues, join link, enquiry, AI or Pro gate exists on the watch. The diary it sends holds only screen events. The open-workout link carries nothing the app reads.
The watch app has no AI and no free text entry: members only tap numbers and effort choices; nothing typed reaches an AI from here.
